requirements.rule: FIRST-EMPLOYMENT C4: select C4_PRIMO_IMPIEGO only for a first-employment office clerk during at most 12 months of effective service. The engine cannot measure effective service or verify first employment; the caller must switch to C4 when eligibility expires. Elapsed calendar months are not a substitute for effective service. The published entry-rate table ends on 31 December 2028; the data model requires an open-ended final period, so a mandatory cutoff redirects to regular C4 on 1 January 2029 rather than paying the entry rate after its published end. The source does not specify an entry rate for 2029.
requirements.remediation: Caller verifies first employment and effective service and switches to C4 after at most 12 months; elapsed-month transition does not measure effective service.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: A1-A9: monthly conglobated salary and ordinary hourly base are available for full-time workers; other pay elements remain limited. A1, A3, A5, A6, A8 work 45 hours/week (Art. 49; hourly divisor 195 under Art. 117(2)); A2, A4, A7, A9 with accommodation work 48 hours/week (Art. 43; hourly divisor 208 under Art. 117(1)). The A-profile hourly coefficients are modelled per level. Free accommodation, electricity, water and heating under Art. 119 are not fully priced: Table A-bis prints only conventional TFR values (accommodation EUR 19.34, energy EUR 1.72, heating EUR 1.72), not a general monthly remuneration value; modelling these as an in-kind allowance would incorrectly include them in other bases. Substitute accommodation and heating depend on conditions not represented here. A-profile post-2004 seniority steps are EUR 10.00 per triennium (Art. 125); the pre-2004 frozen value and historical maturation rules require individual history. The PDF prints 2026-2028 amounts only; the open-ended 2028 period is not evidence of a new 2029 rate. C1 and C2 remain excluded (technical or administrative managers without a fixed hourly ceiling under Art. 62(2)).
requirements.remediation: A-profile hourly coefficients and ordinary hourly base are modelled; accommodation-dependent bases need TFR-only in-kind valuation. C1/C2 need separate schedule evidence.
